additional_info.subject: Handover notes to OCPP Queue
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
FW (v6.0.3) bug
Problem Description:
OCPP Offline Issue Resulting in 0kWh Session After charging (
When OCPP goes offline during charging and comes back after session is finished, Meter Start Value in start transaction is same as Meter Stop Value in Stop Transaction, resulting in 0kWh session even when power was delivered.
)
Charger SW Version
: v6.0.3
Reason for Handover (OCPP)
: Further troubleshooting needed
